common_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D fantasy action game VFX sprite, square PNG, true transparent background with a real alpha channel. Art direction: refined hand-painted synthetic-occult magic matching dark painted armour, clean deliberate silhouette, subtle material shading, crisp controlled light, restrained fine detail that survives reduction to 60 pixels. Neutral grayscale only: pale silver and white highlights, light/mid-gray shading; the game will tint the sprite. Keep luminous strokes bright enough to accept a tint. Flat orthographic graphic, centered with clear transparent margins. No text, labels, characters, environment, UI frame, black/colored background, checkerboard, opaque center, circular backdrop, broad fog, broad bloom, random spark clouds or shadows outside the actual strokes. One coherent isolated VFX sprite, not a sprite sheet or concept board.

asset_prompts.armoured: Six substantial bevelled steel armour plates arranged in a broken circular collar, exactly six separate evenly-spaced curved segments with clearly visible gaps. Strong faceted steel edges, subtle engraved occult slashes limited to the six plates. Outer circle occupies about 84% of the square width, inner empty circle about 62% of width. Complete ring visible, perfectly centered, center fully transparent. Recognizable as protective plate armour at small size. Few strong facets rather than tiny texture.
asset_prompts.vampiric: A thin broken ritual blood ring made of pale luminous liquid strokes, with three strong inward-pointing fang shapes spaced evenly around its circumference. A few angular branching vein tips integrated into the rim. Outer circle about 82% square width; large completely transparent center, inward tips reach no closer than a quarter width from center. Visceral blood-draining identity conveyed by fangs and fluid shapes, while the source sprite remains neutral silver/white grayscale for runtime crimson tint. Clean sparse ring, not a thick filled disk.
asset_prompts.shielded: A precise six-sided occult ward boundary, point-up hexagon, flat front view without perspective, centered. Main hexagonal line thin and continuous, with six small solid faceted corner anchors and a few short secondary inner line segments only near corners. Outer corner radius about 43% of square width. Very large entirely transparent empty interior, no mesh, no opaque fill, no circular disc. Main line roughly 8-12 pixels thick on a 1024-square source so it stays slim when displayed as a large 360-pixel world radius boundary. Protective rune identity through six corners and sparse angular marks, not text. Grayscale white/silver for runtime cyan tint.
asset_prompts.splitting: One horizontal branching rupture / split seam, an irregular angular crack of concentrated white light with restrained gray crystalline edges. Wide horizontal composition across about 84% square width, contained in the middle 26% of height, generous transparent upper/lower space. One strong zigzag core traveling left to right, exactly three substantial shorter branching fissures, pointed tapered endpoints. The crack will overlay an enemy torso, so keep open transparent gaps around and between branches; no stone slab, no object, no surface/background, no debris cloud. Sharp cracked identity, not lightning bolts or glowing blob. Neutral grayscale for runtime lime green.
asset_prompts.fast: One strongly directional three-chevron wind ribbon pointing RIGHT: three separated bold swept arrowhead / feather shapes connected visually by short tapered wind trails that extend LEFT. Compact bright heads on the right, long clean taper toward the left, recognizable fast-forward movement glyph. The complete horizontal sprite spans about 84% square width and middle 28% height; generous transparent space above/below. Curved edges with deliberate sharp forward tips, three main chevrons only, a few smooth wind strokes rather than many speed lines. Grayscale pale silver/white for runtime yellow tint. No surrounding ring, particles or cloud.

notes: Original generated alpha preserved. Runtime art is tinted by each canonical EliteModifiers colour; no generated model name was exposed by the tool.
